chunks: From him, from Zakariyya Al-Mumin, or between him and him is a man, and I do not know him except that he narrated to me from Ammar Al-Sajistani, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying to a slave of his: 'Go and say to the judge: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The limit of the woman is that she is entered into by her husband when she is a daughter of nine years.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.زَكَرِيَّا الْمُؤْمِنِ: Zakariyya Al-Mumin (The Believer), a narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal age for a woman to be eligible for marital consummation according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the legal age of puberty for women regarding marital consummation, citing a statement from the Prophet (peace be upon him) transmitted by Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). It specifies that a girl reaches the age of nine years, at which point she is considered mature enough for her husband to enter into her. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration serves as a primary textual basis for the concept of 'bulugh' (puberty) distinct from 'rushd' (maturity), allowing for consummation at nine provided there is no harm (darar), while scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Mufid and Al-Tusi have debated whether this age is a minimum threshold or a standard for full legal capacity.
